state.title: State
state.description: State is whether support requests can currently be opened from the Cluster.

message.description: Message is a human-readable explanation of the state when it is not AVAILABLE.

organization.description: Organization is the organization that the Cluster's License was issued to. It is only set once the License was accepted by Octelium.

clusterDomain.description: ClusterDomain is the domain of the Cluster.

supportLevel.title: Support Level
supportLevel.description: SupportLevel is a support level as defined by the Octelium Support SLA.

limits.description: Limits are the limits of the support requests.

environment.description: Environment is the set of the Cluster details (e.g. the installed versions and the Regions) that are sent along with every new request.

portalURL.description: PortalURL is the URL of the Octelium customer portal.

supportEmail.description: SupportEmail is the email address of Octelium Support.

installationID.description: InstallationID is a short identifier of the Cluster installation that Octelium Support can use to recognize the requests of the Cluster.

SupportInfo.title: Support Info
SupportInfo.description: SupportInfo describes whether and how support requests can be opened from the Cluster.

maxSubjectLength.description: MaxSubjectLength is the maximum length of the subject of a request.

maxBodyLength.description: MaxBodyLength is the maximum length of a description or a reply.

maxAttachmentSize.description: MaxAttachmentSize is the maximum size in bytes of a file.

maxAttachmentsPerRequest.description: MaxAttachmentsPerRequest is the maximum number of files of a request.

maxAttachmentsPerMessage.description: MaxAttachmentsPerMessage is the maximum number of files that a reply can reference.

attachmentExtensions.description: AttachmentExtensions is the list of the accepted file extensions.

autoCloseDays.description: AutoCloseDays is the number of days after which a resolved request is closed.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportI.title: Limits
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportI.description: Limits are the limits of the support requests.

uid.description: UID is the unique identifier of the organization.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the human-readable name of the organization.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportI.title: Organization
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SupportI.description: Organization is the organization that the Cluster's License was issued to.
